items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Even Bill Clevenger wants to get a rig, has been wanting to get a rig for his mandolin for years, you know, an electrical pickup.

ctx.x: It is weak tone. You'll have to admit it.

Yeah, they're frustrated. You know, they had all these trombones blowing their heads off in a flock of cornets in the back, like when he was with Whiteman, you know. And there his poor little guitar there, nobody could hear it. What are you going to do with it? You know, no. You've got to put a microphone right in front of it. Well, the electric guitar takes the place of that. And of course, we all think it's a horrible sound, and I'll never get over thinking how horrible that sound is, and I'll never like them.…
